description: A 3-axis accelerometer producing one stream named after the instance. Implemented by the ADXL355, ADXL345 and the simulated sensor (sim); info.limits narrows ranges to what the hardware supports.

odr_hz.description: Output data rate. Usable bandwidth is roughly a quarter of this.

mounting.description: How the sensor is installed. Stored as metadata; data stays in sensor axes.

axis_map.description: 3x3, rows = reported axes, columns = sensor axes.

temperature_c.description: Sensor die temperature, if the hardware has one.

self_test.description: Run the sensor's built-in self-test. Returns busy while recording.

events.sensor_error: The sensor stopped responding or returned impossible values.
